text:
### Musée Fabre — official website

The official Musée Fabre exhibitions page is: **[museefabre.fr/expositions](https://www.museefabre.fr/expositions)**. ([museefabre.fr](https://www.museefabre.fr/expositions?utm_source=openai))

### 2026 exhibitions in Montpellier

- **L’École des Beaux-Arts de Montpellier : une histoire singulière**  
  **31 January–3 May 2026** — held at the MO.CO. ([museefabre.fr](https://www.museefabre.fr/sites/default/files/2025-11/cp_ecole_des_beaux_arts_de_montpellier_une_histoire_singuliere_moco.pdf?utm_source=openai))

- **Le design selon Pierre Paulin (1927–2009)**  
  **27 June–1 November 2026** — the Musée Fabre’s first major exhibition devoted to 20th-century design. ([museefabre.fr](https://www.museefabre.fr/index.php/EXPOSITIONS?utm_source=openai))

- **Guimet+ Chine**  
  **13 December 2025–1 November 2026** — an exhibition presented at the Hôtel de Cabrières-Sabatier d’Espeyran. ([museefabre.fr](https://www.museefabre.fr/informations-pratiques?utm_source=openai))

- **Guimet+ monde indien**  
  **5 December 2026–31 October 2027** — Indian art from the Musée Guimet partnership. ([museefabre.fr](https://www.museefabre.fr/expositions?utm_source=openai))

- **Les Mystères d’Hérodiade — enquête au musée Fabre**  
  **18 December 2026–18 April 2027** — upcoming temporary exhibition. ([museefabre.fr](https://www.museefabre.fr/expositions?utm_source=openai))

As of **15 November 2026**, the next scheduled exhibitions are **Guimet+ monde indien**, opening **5 December 2026**, and **Les Mystères d’Hérodiade**, opening **18 December 2026**. ([museefabre.fr](https://www.museefabre.fr/?utm_source=openai))
